<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
    return d
def key(d): return {k:v for k,v in d.items() if k in 'bMNcY'}
base=snap(current_frame)
print("base bar:",base.get('b'))
tests=[("magenta",5,37),("leftU",55,21),("rightU",55,45),("center",31,31)]
for name,r,c in tests:
    before=snap(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after=snap(current_frame)
    won=bool(last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'))
    chg={k:(before.get(k),after.get(k)) for k in set(before)|set(after) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)}
    print(name,"won:",won,"changed:",list(chg.keys()))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
